description: A real runtime failure (project directory unreadable, EACCES) does not show "This project didn't open.". It shows a page titled only "Pardner" with "The project board isn't reachable yet.", "Project runtime failed to start; retrying after 5s" and a single **Retry connection** button. The project name is not shown, there is no switcher and no Open another project. Reloading returns to the same screen because last-project still points at the failing project, so the person cannot reach any of their other two working projects until the runtime recovers.
expected: The failing screen names the project and offers a way to open any other project (switcher or project list), as the "didn't open" screen at least attempts.
actual: Only Retry connection; heading "Pardner"; reload is stuck on the same project.
suggested_fix: Render the app header (with switcher) on the board-unreachable screen, show the project name, and add Open another project.

criterion: One way per task / misleading label
description: **Open another project** opens "Start or join a project" with only **Back to Infra cost cuts**. None of the other projects is listed, so the only exit leads back to the failing project.
expected: "Open another project" lists the person's other projects (with their status) and keeps Start/Join as secondary.
actual: Start/Join form plus Back to the failing project.
suggested_fix: Show the project list above the Start/Join toggle when projects exist, or rename the button to "Start or join a project".

description: The CLIENT_UNREACHABLE failure says the same thing twice: "The local Pardner client did not respond. Check that it is still running, then retry." and "Your local Pardner client may have stopped. Ask your agent to reopen it, then retry."
expected: One message with one instruction (e.g. "Run pardner open, then Retry").
suggested_fix: Drop the JOIN_HINTS line when the message already explains the cause.
